overview: New House No Debt follows the highly personal and emotional journeys of homeowners from across the U.S. who are seeking to sell their properties at a high and purchase a new home completely mortgage-free. While each journey is different from the next, one thing is constant: "Cash is King," and becoming debt-free will change these homeowners' lives!
title: New House No Debt

overview: Single owners of a bed and breakfast (B&B) spread across Europe are looking for the love of their lives. Which Dutch partner dares to look across the border and make the adventure of these owners complete?
title: B&B Vol Liefde

overview: How to find "the one" in today's impossible dating world? A reality show in which four strong successful women attempt to break the cycle of their single life and become truly vested in finding their "New Love". During every cycle, the women and a chosen partner are committed to spend 3 days together in an apartment. During that time the couples experience different situations, change various moods, go out together to various activities encounter challenges and enjoy intimate moments, in their shared apartment. At the end of the 72 hours they had together, the women and their partners need to decide whether they would like to stay together for another 72 hours or would rather break up. Using cameras that network the compound, experts will watch the events and monitor the women, they chose the men for each woman, and they will support them during the process and advise them when needed, giving them the emotional tools to avoid relationships mistakes that they might have done in the past. Full of emotions, drama, and laughter, like a real life and authentic soap opera, it's a boot camp of relationships which we all can identify with.
title: New Love

overview: British comedian Daisy Donovan explores opportunities across the USA, poking fun at herself and the people she meets.
title: Daisy Does America

overview: The year is 1988. A mysterious object is falling in the vicinity of a small Soviet town located in the area of a powerful missile defense system radar. The most ordinary sixth graders Lech, Tolya and Sema go in search of a meteorite in anticipation of fame and fame. While wandering through the forest, Lech gets lost. His search in the forest by police forces starts a chain of events that lead to the contact of one of the locals with something very strange. Soon, mysterious events begin to occur in the city, and those very schoolchildren are among the first to pay attention to them. They notice that people seem to have been replaced and these "substituted" people behave extremely suspiciously: they do strange things and talk about incomprehensible things. The guys come to the conclusion that they are facing spies or saboteurs who are preparing a provocation in the city or on the radar. But in reality, everything is much scarier.… The main characters only have to solve the mystery of the meteorite, face to face with the inexplicable and unknown.
title: Радар

overview: The "human gourmet love story" begins when Tomoya Ishida, a rookie editor at a women's magazine who is still unsure of his job environment, is asked by a more experienced colleague to take charge of a regular food column written by an old man named Ayumu Mitsuya. Ishida decides to visit Mitsuya, and upon meeting Mitsuya, he sees him as a charming, witty gentleman with a cute side who can cook a delicious dish. Ishida's interactions with Mitsuya begin to make the younger editor more comfortable in his job, and he begins to see Mitsuya not just as a work partner, but as something else entirely.
title: Mr. Mitsuya's Planned Feeding

overview: Beauty consultant Natsume Mamiya is forced to work as a pair with Touma Sahashi, his junior. On top of everything, Touma — who has no respect for his work or for Natsume — has usurped his throne as the top seller! One day, Touma finds out Natsume is gay and uses this to his advantage in a power-play, coercing Natsume to become his friend with benefits! Enjoy the behind-the-scenes of the hottest cosmetics counter ever, and prepare to swoon! The extra story and bonus chapter feature even more sensual kissing… and a secret, steamy hookup scene!
title: Cosmetic Playlover

overview: Jattawa, a 19-year-old girl with the power to stop and rewind time for ten minutes each day, meets her soulmate Four, a fierce fourth-year university student, for the first time on a strange day when it snows in Thailand. This coincides with a prophecy made by her younger sister, Vivi. However, this fate cannot be avoided. If Jattawa and Four become lovers, she will lose her beloved sister. Can Jattawa cheat fate to save both her sister and her lover?
title: Reverse 4 You

overview: To escape a politically motivated arranged marriage, a privileged heir Lucas Walton fakes being gay and engaged to his company's new executive, unaware that his "fiancé" is actually an undercover agent investigating his family's corrupt dealings, leading to a hilarious clash of secrets, danger, and unexpected feelings.
title: My Secret Agent Husband

overview: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries takes place during Aurora's post-college days when she finds herself back home in Lawrenceton. While her mother, Aida struggles to keep her newfound real estate business, Aurora supports herself by working as a teacher's assistant in a crime fiction class and waitresses at the local diner at night, where she shares her love of researching true crime with her friend, Sally, and police officer, Arthur.
title: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries

overview: Sandringham; the Royal Family's favourite holiday home. For over 160 years, kings and queens have come to this 274-room retreat to relax in the privacy of the Norfolk countryside. But what really goes on behind the imposing iron gates? In this series, Nigel Havers reveals the surprising secrets of Sandringham House and its vast 20,000-acre estate. With the help of JJ Chalmers and Raksha Dave we find out what daily life was like for those upstairs and downstairs – and discover why the house had its own time zone for close to a century. We discover the terrifying disaster that almost destroyed the house while Queen Elizabeth II slept inside, and find out just how the royals celebrate Christmas. And we even uncover the story of Sandringham's secret house, where the royals go to hide. CGI shows how the iconic building has transformed across the centuries as a long line of monarchs added everything from a private bowling alley and home cinema to its very own post office and on-site fire brigade.
title: Sandringham: A Royal Residence with Nigel Havers

overview: A cousin to the Vanderbilts and a society page reporter for the Newport Observer, Emma Cross is tasked with solving the mysteries that plague her powerful family.
title: Gilded Newport Mysteries

overview: An American psychologist, hired to coach a fashion designer, helps a guarded French detective unravel a list of fashionable suspects after a murder happens backstage of a Paris fashion show.
title: Crimes of Fashion

overview: During the last two decades, aging punk rocker Vernon, has spent much of his time in the pub whilst living off his high-flying wife! Now, following a particularly nasty divorce, middle-aged divorcée Vernon moves into the student accommodation with his teenage kids, much to their disgust and dismay, in order to carry on living his rebellious (so he thinks) lifestyle.
title: Teenage Kicks

overview: Pack your gear - Fox's own Katie Pavlich takes us to some of the most stunning, tricked out hunting and fishing lodges America has to offer. Check out the views, wildlife and top tier accommodations from the snowy Wyoming mountains, to the sizzling Louisiana swamps.
title: Luxury Hunting Lodges of America

overview: Ji Woon goes to a café after receiving a call from his ex-boyfriend Tae Ha. Ji Woon, who is waiting for his ex with excitement, wondering if anything will happen, hears from Tae Ha that he is getting married to So Hee. Ji Woon is shocked and disappointed, but Tae Ha smiles regardless. Ji Woon then feels a burning desire for revenge on Tae Ha.
title: Bad Guy

overview: Shaken by the Covid-19 pandemic and the war in Ukraine, Europe is facing immense challenges: its dependence on fossil fuels, waves of migration, and collapsing biodiversity. But while some might think that's a cause for despair, for some Europeans, it's a call to action.
title: Europe, un continent bouleversé

overview: Highlights of the Olympics from Paris.
title: Paris Olympics 2024: Today

overview: Further highlights from the Paris Olympics.
title: Paris Olympics 2024: Tonight

overview: Meet the experts who make the Smithsonian Gardens a stunning living museum year round. See how our horticulturists work tirelessly to overcome urban conditions and freezing temperatures. Learn how all gardeners, from amateur to seasoned, can use their secrets to make their own gardens grow.
title: Garden Secrets

overview: A documentary series dedicated to mountain biking, introducing riders and the passion that goes into making a lifestyle out of riding a bike.
title: MTB Heroes

overview: Domhan an Dulra looks at the stunning, majestic, chilling beauty of some of the most wildest places in the world.
title: Domhan an Dúlra

overview: At Anusorn Witthayalai High School there's a story that every 4 years 8 students have to die. What is the truth behind this "8 deaths curse"?
title: First Degree

overview: Twenty Good Years revolves around John Mason and Jeffrey Pyne, two polar opposites who disagree on just about everything. The only thing upon which they do agree is that they only have about twenty good years left to live. At John's birthday party, they both decide to spend their last good years doing things they've never done before.
title: Twenty Good Years

overview: Provincial 23-year-old Andrey has long settled down in Moscow. Here he found his love - a 45-year-old beauty. He is not at all embarrassed by the big age difference; the newly minted "Macron" is so captivated by his girlfriend that he is ready to go with her to the registry office even tomorrow. Soon Andrei comes to his native village for his mother's birthday. And he shows up at the house not alone, but with his chosen one. A guy in love introduces the lady of his heart to his parents, but they are far from delighted with his romance with a woman who is their same age...
title: Макрон

overview: After getting drunk, Xiaonan accidentally entered the dream catcher of the dream hunter Lao Li and absorbed the dream spirit of a hundred years. The two went to the Dream Painting Academy for help, trying to draw out the dream spirit, but they didn't expect that Xiaonan was a dreamless person. Lao Li had to accept Xiaonan as his apprentice and teach him the way of dream catching. Under the guidance of the four teachers of pen, ink, paper and inkstone, Xiaonan inherited Lao Li's mantle, but Lao Li suddenly disappeared. In order to find Lao Li, Xiaonan came to the Miaobi Gallery and became a security guard. Here he met his senior sister...
title: The Dream Weaver

overview: This ancient romance, which combines elements of time travel, medicine, love, and palace struggle, tells the story of a modern female special forces soldier who accidentally travels to ancient times and becomes a medical fairy with peerless medical skills. Not only does she have extraordinary talent in medical skills, but she also uses her unique personality and wisdom to navigate the complex palace life with ease. In ancient times, she met a handsome and powerful prince, and a complex, love-hate relationship unfolded between the two. The prince was originally cold and ruthless, but the appearance of the medical fairy gradually changed him, allowing him to experience the warmth of love and the brilliance of human nature. However, the power struggles in the palace and the misunderstandings between them made their love journey full of twists and turns and challenges.
title: Phoenix from Another World

overview: The ninth princess of the Southern Kingdom, Hongdou, grew up smart and mature, read the art of war and strategy, and hid her talent to avoid the front line. Later, she came to the throne by thunderous means and crowned herself the Empress. On the night of her ascension to the throne, Hongdou travelled to modern times and met the star Ye Xing. Ye Xing and Hong Dou, a pair of happy couple, tried all kinds of ways to help Hong Dou to cross back to the southern country. When Hongdou returned to the southern country began to vigorously reorganise the country, but did not know that Ye Xing also followed the crossing to the southern country, and became Hongdou's "male favourite". Thus, the happy couple began to play the court version of the battle of wits.
title: Hong Dou's Journey Through Time

overview: The story follows Feng Yuji, a woman living under an assumed name, who returns to the Shen household under the guise of her twin sister, the young mistress of the Shen family, to seek revenge for her sister. She gets close to Shen Tanqian, the son of a wealthy merchant, and begins investigating the truth behind a long-buried murder case, ultimately revealing the true culprit and ensuring they face justice. Throughout this journey, Feng Yuji and Shen Tanqian move from mutual distrust to open honesty, and eventually, they heal each other. With courage, wisdom, and the power of their sacrificial love, they bring the truth to light. As the truth unfolds, their combined efforts also eradicate the Shen family's opium trade with the Japanese, gradually ending the city's opium addiction and establishing a new era of science and civilization.
title: First Marriage

overview: The story follows Gu Pingyuan, a scholar who is falsely accused and exiled. Faking his death to survive, he navigates treacherous political and social landscapes, strategically leveraging opportunities to rise again. Starting with a money exchange business, he builds his fortune through tea, establishes his enterprise with salt, and eventually provides grain to feed the people. Through his unique methods and resilience, he stages a powerful comeback in the business world, ultimately becoming a great merchant who brings prosperity to his region.
title: Legend of the Magnate

overview: Starved is "a comedic take on food addiction, which is used as the backdrop to the funny, romantic and personal misadventures of the four characters". Schaeffer will star as a neurotic Wall Streeter living in Brooklyn who's friends with a bulimic cop (Sterling K. Brown, "Brown Sugar"), an overweight writer (Del Pentecost, "Kingdom Hospital") and an anorexic would-be songwriter (Broadway actress Laura Benanti, "Nine").
title: Starved

overview: When Jinxiu Kingdom is on the brink of defeat in the battle at Pingling, the female archer in red, Fu Yixiao, shoots an arrow at Susha's eldest prince, Feng Suige, turning the tide of the battle. But Yixiao accidentally falls off a cliff shortly after and loses her memory. After Yixiao is rescued by the Ling family of doctors of the Righteous Villa, she unexpectedly reunites with her old enemy Suige. Looking at the mess Yixiao is in, Suige infers that it must be related to his predicament in the battle at Pingling. Suige wants to use Yixiao to find out the truth behind the scenes, while Yixiao wants to use Suige to survive under heavy pursuit. So the two, who were mortal enemies a month ago, must now rely on each other to survive in the turbulent Yujing City, and their love secretly blossoms through countless near-death experiences. The seeds have been sown, and amid the hatred, betrayal, deception, unrequited desire, and inability to let go, everyone is both a player and a pawn. Yixiao and Suige can only work closely together in the storm to overcome the dark conspiracy, break the shackles of fate, live up to the people expectations, and not let each other down.
title: Fated Hearts

overview: The story follows Detective Captain Peng Zhaolin, who remains steadfast in his commitment to justice. In a decade-long pursuit spanning thousands of miles, he relentlessly battles the forces of darkness, ultimately bringing an extremely obsessive and merciless murderer to justice. Starring acclaimed actors Guo Jingfei, Wang Qianyuan, and Zhao Jinmai, the film is directed by Cao Kai and written by Chen Ping. It highlights the unwavering belief and perseverance of the people's police, embodying the triumph of good over evil and the enduring power of justice.
title: Drifting Away

overview: Host Monét X Change gathers the funniest people you know to kiki and play some salacious games.
title: Monét's Slumber Party

overview: A dating show with a difference for the whole family, Ma Mère, Ton Père follows a group of single parents who have been nominated by their young adult kids for a second chance at love. Throughout the season, viewers will follow these parents from all walks of life as they live together in a stunning country house retreat with one objective: to find true love.
title: Ma Mère, Ton Père

overview: Moja mama i twój tata is a dating program in which the characters are mature singles who have been through a lot and are looking for love. Each of them has different life experiences and a different story. Parents will seek love with the help of those who know them best - their own children. The adults will live in a Masurian villa, completely cut off from the outside world. They will decide to spend a few weeks getting to know and discover each other, building relationships, and surprising themselves in completely new circumstances. The program participants are experienced 40- and 50-year-olds whose stories will become close to many viewers. Moja mama i twój tatais is also a program about beautiful emotions, relationships with loved ones, but also about the hardships of everyday life.
title: Moja mama i twój tata

overview: Shu Yawang grew up with her adopted brother Xia Mu and her childhood sweetheart Tang Xiaotian. Their happy and carefree lives were disrupted by Tang Xiaotian's senior, Qu Weiran. Driven by his possessive desire for Shu Yawang, Qu Weiran schemed to have her sexually assaulted. In the ensuing chaos, Xia Mu accidentally injured Qu Weiran. To protect Xia Mu, Shu Yawang married Qu Weiran under the pretense of being pregnant. However, after her miscarriage, she went into hiding and changed her identity. Four years later, Shu Yawang returned to her hometown, where she unexpectedly reunited with Xia Mu, Qu Weiran, and Tang Xiaotian, reigniting the emotional entanglements between the four of them.
title: Sweet Sixteen

overview: The gruelling, epic battles, which determine survival in the natural world. Each episode follows the build-up, the battle, and the aftermath of three dramatic encounters.
title: Gladiators

overview: Remember when watching the weather forecast was a soothing alternative to the news? These days the weather forecast is the news and it feels like every other day becomes the hottest, coldest, dampest or driest ever recorded somewhere. What should we know about major storms? How should we prepare for a world where the only thing that's predictable, is unpredictability? This series answers some of these vital questions, with an in-depth look at the increase in major weather events, and their consequences and with our panel of experts, scientists and meteorologists. So pack your survival gear, cause there's some extreme weather on the way, in Fatal Forecast! We communicate via satellite and can put people on the moon, surely we can do a better job of predicting the weather? Why are some weather events still so difficult to predict? Are ‘we' getting any better at predicting these events? What technology exists to manipulate the weather?
title: Fatal Forecast

overview: Güneş is a young woman who has just graduated from university and is preparing to go abroad to pursue her ideals. When Güneş's brother is imprisoned due to a false accusation, her path crosses with Ayaz, the heir to a large and prestigious holding. Fate tests the two young people through the lives of their loved ones, pushing Güneş to play a dangerous game to save her brother. However, the rules of this game will be disrupted by love. As Ayaz's heart, frozen in ice years ago, warms with Güneş's presence, life shows its ruthless face to them both without hesitation. In a journey woven with secrets and intrigues, Ayaz and Güneş fight battles where both their salvation and captivity will be love.
title: Ayazın Sonu Güneş

overview: In its early days, online dating was seen as a last-ditch effort for many people to try to find a mate. But as the Internet has matured, so has the opinion of looking for love online. Each episode of this docuseries follows two men as they search for their ideal partner or just a fling. Cameras follow the bachelors -- hopefully they're bachelors -- from the first communication with a potential match to landing the date, including all of the trials and tribulations that come with digital dating. The type of men featured on the show range from guys who are just looking to get lucky to the classic romantic looking for true love.
title: Online Dating Rituals of the American Male

overview: Adolescence tells the story of how a family's world is turned upside down when 13-year-old Jamie Miller is arrested and charged with the murder of a teenage girl who goes to his school.
title: Adolescence

overview: Inspired by the Thai horror radio show "Angkhan Khlumpong," this series presents eight stories based on real-life experiences shared by listeners.
title: Terror Tuesday: Extreme

overview: Joe Daymond and Kara Rickard travel around Aotearoa, uncovering the origins of our place names. Delving deep into our history uncovering the good, the bad and the ugly.
title: Get the Name Right

overview: This drama follows three women who work at a police station, who are smart but struggle with interpersonal relationships. They adhere to a ‘no overtime' motto and end up providing assistance in solving cases during weekend gatherings.
title: Geeks: Keisatsusho no Henjintachi

overview: Cowboy Cartel features the extraordinary story of the rookie FBI agent who cracked the case of one of Mexico's most ruthless cartels, Los Zetas, and the multimillion-dollar money laundering operation they ran through the heart of the American Quarter Horse racing industry.
title: Cowboy Cartel

overview: With exclusive access to the UK's leading dog welfare charity, Dogs Trust, this series will see Pete meet the four-legged friends that call it home. From the moment the dogs are rescued, Pete will play an instrumental role in their rehabilitation process, right up until the point the dogs are safely rehomed.
title: Pete Wicks: For Dogs' Sake

overview: Big Cats 24/7 follows the lives of lions, cheetahs and leopards in the Okavango Delta, Botswana, a place described as one of Africa's last wildernesses. With extraordinary, unparalleled access in a rarely visited area and the opportunity to film from the ground, the air and through the night, the Big Cat 24/7 team work together to follow the cats' lives around the clock.
title: Big Cats 24/7

overview: A television program for children following the adventures of Jini Mê from number 6, Allt Gefn, Graig Las and her friends.
title: Anturiaethau Jini Mê

overview: Emily Sanders has many things going for her. She's young, single, has terrific friends and a great job in publishing. In fact, she's got the hottest selling book in town. Unfortunately, she's just closed the chapter on her relationship with the roguishly handsome, two-timing author. Based on the bestselling novel of one successful single woman's search for love, this smart and stylish comedy explores life, love and sex in the city from an independent woman's point of view.
title: Emily's Reasons Why Not

overview: Storytelling for younger viewers.
title: Cadi Ha

overview: The play is adapted based on Guoguo's novel of the same name. Big Demon Qi Fengyin (acted by Li Hongyi), born out of evil thoughts, is locked in the Panic Mountain Barrier due to his killing of the mortals and immortals a thousand years ago. The small Medicine Spirit Yamao (acted by Sun Zhenni), transformed from the herb Huanyangcao, is chased by all sorts of people due to its magic physique and happens to break in the barrier, leading Qi Fengyin's failure to have a human body and his evil thoughts fly. Since then, the two have had a deep bond and have experienced all kinds of stories together.
title: Blossom in Darkness

overview: With a 20-year acting career, Cho Jung Seok takes on the challenge of debuting as a singer in 100 days, mobilizing his entire network against the clock!
title: A-List to Playlist

overview: Following the story of the main characters Korn and Dream as they strive to achieve their entrepreneurial dreams within the Sandbox program. The series focuses on their personal and professional challenges as well as their relationships and family dynamics.
title: Start-Up

overview: Breaking the Faith shares the story of eight young men and women who are trying to build a new life outside of the FLDS - either by choice, or by force. The young men, known as lost boys, are cast-outs from their homes and not welcomed back, while the women are escaping the controlling ways of the community - including arranged marriage and a life of complete submission, known as "keeping sweet" - and are hoping for a better life on the outside. Leaving a world where every decision was made for them, they are now dealing with the challenges of living in a reality where they are now responsible for every move they make. And, for this group, being faced with making life-altering choices in their effort to win their freedom comes with the fear that consequences for leaving the compound will come without warning.
title: Breaking the Faith

overview: Get ready to laugh-out-loud as Guy Montgomery and his loyal assistant Aaron Chen are joined by some of Australia's favourite personalities, testing their spelling prowess with wildly inventive spelling challenges designed to befuddle, bamboozle, and bedazzle them all.
title: Guy Montgomery's Guy Mont Spelling Bee

overview: Ming Jia Jia works as a private detective and fixer while trying to find out the truth behind her father being labeled as the arsonist of a huge fire from 10 years before. She encounters Jiang Chen while working on a case, and discovers that their stories are entangled.
title: Zui Ai

overview: Comedy sketches for children.
title: Teliffant

overview: A children's entertainment program which takes them in to different imaginary worlds through various doors in a large revolving carousel set.
title: Troi a Throi

overview: In New York City's war on crime, the worst criminal offenders are pursued by the detectives of the Major Case Squad. These are their stories.
title: Law & Order: Criminal Intent

overview: Love Prison is a reality series that documents couples who are dating online, but have yet to meet in person. These couples have agreed to take their relationship to the next level and meet face-to-face while living in a house on a deserted island for one week. These couples will have plenty of time to get to know one another when they are stripped of their comforts, electronics, and any distraction from one another. Will their carefully crafted cyber love become all too real or will they last the week and leave the island together?
title: Love Prison

overview: Sakuma Shunsuke works with numerous clients as a planner for an advertising agency. He is somewhat of a mysterious man and popular with women. He deals with his work and his personal life in the same manner, like he is playing a game. He is currently working on a large project involving a car company. The project is progressing well, but he is suddenly excluded from the project by the car company's vice president, Katsuragi Katsutoshi. Shunsuke's pride is wounded by his exclusion, and he becomes extremely upset about it. He happens to meet Katsuragi Juri, who is Katsutoshi's daughter. She also holds a grudge against her father. Shunsuke and Juri decide to team up to get revenge. They take part in a kidnapping game.
title: The Name of the Game is Kidnapping

overview: La casa de los espíritus is a magnificent family saga that tells the epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.
title: La casa de los espíritus

overview: In 1994, 19-year-old Melissa Witt went missing from an Arkansas bowling alley. After six weeks of a community-wide search effort, Melissa's body was found deep in the Ozark National Forest, 50 miles from where she disappeared. Thirty years later, the new docuseries explores the ongoing search for answers in Melissa's case and follows new investigators as they comb through extensive evidence, uncovering new information in the decades-long search for her killer.
title: At Witt's End: The Hunt for a Killer

overview: In Vogue: The 90s tells the definitive story of the fashion industry in the 90s through the eyes of Vogue editors, Hamish Bowles, Edward Enninful, Tonne Goodman and Anna Wintour.
title: In Vogue: The 90s

overview: Renowned chef Jason Atherton dives into Dubai's rich & diverse gastronomic heritage in this new culinary series about one of the fastest-growing foodie hubs in the world.
title: Jason Atherton's Dubai Dishes

overview: The impact of 1970s British sex comedies, which both saved the British film industry from financial ruin and transformed a nation's attitudes to sex.
title: Saucy! Secrets of the British Sex Comedy

overview: Set in the sweltering heat of Atlanta, Anna lives in haunting reclusion, fading away from her friends and career as a journalist. But when she overhears talk about a murder in Dahlonega — the sleepy north Georgia town where she grew up — Anna is snapped back to life, pouncing on the case and searching for answers. Detective Jack Harper is strangely suspicious of her involvement, chasing her into the crosshairs of his own investigation.
title: His & Hers

overview: Ana Francisca is a humble, romantic and naive girl who awakens Danilo's interest in the small town of Ventura, famous for its artisanal chocolates and cakes.
title: Chocolate com Pimenta

overview: Alien Disclosure Files explores UAP enigmas, historic encounters, UFOs, government secrets, Mars mysteries, and more. Are they from the past, future, or distant galaxies? Unveil the truth, revelation by revelation.
title: Alien Disclosure Files

overview: Eight unsuspecting bad boyfriends will be flown to a Greek island under the premise of filming a series about manhood and bromance in a hedonistic holiday mecca, before getting the shock of their lives when Olivia appears to announce their wild partying days are on hold and to reveal the true purpose of the show - to whip them into better boyfriend shape. All at the behest of their long-suffering girlfriends, whose surprise, dramatic arrivals cause mayhem. But Olivia has her work cut out attempting to reform this wayward bunch of boys from serial cheaters and lazy lovers, to commitment-phobes and man-children, it's time to shape up or ship out.
title: Olivia Attwood's Bad Boyfriends
娇宠之祁总追妻甜入骨

overview: It's 1914, the Great War rages, millions of men have shipped off to join the fight, yet in the sleepy English village of Rittle-on-Sea, three young chaps, Cecil (Bird), George (Thomas), and Bert (Sweet), have stayed behind. Cecil would love to have earned his battle stripes and has all the makings of a brave soldier, but isn't physically fit to fight on account of his flat feet. Pacifist teacher George, on the other hand, has no intention of being a part of the conflict because he fundamentally disagrees with it, and Bert, well, he hasn't got a clue what's going on, an outstanding liar and unscrupulous cad who should be in the army and has no legitimate reason not to be. Lumping the boys together and labelling them cowards, the ladies of Rittle-on-Sea are none-too-pleased about their decision to stick around, including Cecil's sister Agnes (Emerald Fennell, Any Human Heart), and Winky (Sarah Daykin, Dead Boss), George's increasingly embarrassed fiance.
title: Chickens

overview: Forced into hiding in a mysterious house after a tragic accident, Razan and her two children soon discover that the mysteries within its walls are the least of their worries.
title: The Cursed House
